'''Sunshield fabric''' was a type of fabric that could be used as a [[Cloak/Legends|cloak]] or a [[Blanket/Legends|blanket]]. Sunshield fabric was used in [[Coolth backpack/Legends|Coolth backpacks]],<ref name="AEG">''[[Arms & Equipment Guide]]''</ref> and sunshield rolls were standard equipment in [[field kit]]s.<ref name="RPG-Core">''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game Core Rulebook]]''</ref>
